preconditions.description: The number of points n must be between 3 and 70 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(initial_positions) == 3 and all(1 <= pos <= n for pos in initial_positions)
preconditions.description: The initial positions of the stones must be three distinct integers between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == n for row in color_matrix) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz*' for row in color_matrix for c in row)
preconditions.description: The color matrix must be an n x n matrix with valid color characters or '*' for the main diagonal.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not reachable else True
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to move the stones to vertices 1, 2, and 3, output -1.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith(str(min_moves)) and all(len(move.split()) == 2 for move in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: If reachable, output the minimal number of moves followed by the moves in the specified format.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(move.split()[0]) <= n and 1 <= int(move.split()[1]) <= n for move in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each move must specify valid source and destination vertices within the range of 1 to n.
